lābellum

lābellum, lābellī n.

noun, second declension

washbasin, sink

In this lexicon

  • washbasin

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 125; Cato, Agr. 10.2; Columella

  • lābellum intimum: toilet bowl

Notes

  1. 1lābellum: long a (Lewis & Short labellum, with a short a). De Vaan, s.v. lavō: lābrum < *lavābrum, whence the long ā of the diminutive. Ruling: Which authority settles a vowel.

Examples

  • Theodōrus, priusquam exīret, ad lābellum minimum manūs lāvit.

    Before he came out, Theo washed his hands at the tiny basin.Libellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam
